packageRules.description: package.json's packageManager pin must equal the pnpm nixpkgs supplies; the pnpm-version-matches check in flake.nix fails the build when they drift, because CI's pnpm/action-setup resolves the lockfile with the declared pnpm while fetchPnpmDeps consumes it with the nixpkgs one. Renovate can only move one side, so every bump it proposes fails that check (#123). Bumping pnpm is a two-part change — packageManager plus the nixpkgs input — so it is done by hand, not by Renovate. Note this disables the update rather than capping it with allowedVersions: a cap would retype the nixpkgs pnpm version into a third location, which is the drift this rule exists to prevent.
